name: list_thread_assets
description: List durable assets from an owned Computer thread, including generated files. Returns asset_id, entry_id, filename, mime_type, asset_type, created_at, and is_primary_asset. A null primary flag means the source entry is unavailable. Supply entry_id to filter a turn. Follow next_cursor even when a filtered page is empty. Use create_asset_download for a fresh URL.

name: create_asset_download
description: Create a fresh HTTPS download URL for an accessible asset in an owned Computer thread. Use asset_id from list_thread_assets. expires_in_seconds is the remaining URL lifetime, or null for a URL without a known expiration. Request another URL after expiration.
